changelog:
Conqueror SEO Coach - Initial Release

- Launches a friendly, beginner-focused SEO coaching mode for Conqueror.
- Explains the purpose of each Conqueror workflow and guides on which to use.
- Recommends next steps tailored to user experience and project needs.
- Clarifies when to use MCP data, web search, GSC, or local files.
- Provides actionable, concise coaching with guardrails for beginners.
summary: Friendly SEO coach mode: explain what each Conqueror workflow does, recommend the next step, and teach when to use MCP data versus web search. Use when unsure which workflow to run. Requires a connected Conqueror MCP server.
